turns.question: Which of 1 or 2 October 2026 had more precipitation in Amsterdam, and how many orders were placed by customers in the Netherlands on that day?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no precipitation metric, so I cannot say which day had more rain in Amsterdam; the closest metrics, orders and revenue by customer country, do not measure weather. Orders placed by Netherlands customers were 3 on 1 October 2026 and 3 on 2 October 2026 (orders, per day), and the freshness statement is: Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
